content: Video consultations facilitate direct, face-to-face interactions between patients and healthcare providers, which helps to build trust and allows for immediate, real-time feedback on diabetes management. Remote patient monitoring enables healthcare providers to continuously track critical patient metrics, such as blood glucose levels, in real-time. This eliminates the need for frequent in-person visits while ensuring timely interventions when necessary. Digital communication methods, such as text messaging and email, provide patients with ongoing support and guidance outside of scheduled appointments, ensuring continuous care and addressing concerns as they arise.
